summary: Every library var has a hand-written reference page at vars/<name>.md; the site publishes them under reference/ through the docs/pages/reference -> ../../vars symlink, and Jenkins never copies them. check_site.py (in kc project test) fails, naming the var, when a var has no page, and on a page for no var; I made each failure happen and saw it fail. Gate is green; the 8 example snippets pass the controller's declarative linter; close-out B1 records a gitUtils.getTreeHashFile defect.
